title: Disclosing fees and costs in PDSs and periodic statements
subject: This guide explains how fees and costs should be disclosed in Product Disclosure Statements (PDSs), shorter PDSs, IDPS Guides, and periodic statements for certain superannuation products, managed investment products, notified foreign passport funds, and platform operators.
background: The guide operates under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) and the SIS Act 1993 (Cth). It is intended for issuers of superannuation products, managed investment products, operators of notified foreign passport funds, and platform operators to assist them in complying with fee and cost disclosure obligations.
ruling: ASIC provides detailed guidance on how to calculate and present fees and costs in disclosure documents, including specifying that administration fees and costs that do not change with the balance must be disclosed separately. The guide interprets the legislative requirements for fee disclosure in a manner that aims to improve transparency and comparability for consumers. It sets out the format and content requirements for PDSs and periodic statements, including specific labeling and calculation methodologies under the Corporations Regulations. ASIC also clarifies the application of the 'Protecting Your Super' package reforms to fee disclosure.
